summary: Re-verification round for the 5 fixes from iteration_1 plus new mobile-optimization requirement. Backend: existing pytest suite /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py rerun -> 14/14 pass (28.5s); /api/prices returns 15 TLDs with 15 distinct curated example sets (0 identical groups). Frontend (Playwright 1920x1080, 390x844, 360x740): buy-button overflow FIXED (all 15 buy buttons scrollWidth==clientWidth, 232/232 in the 282px 5-col cards, share/copy icons now on their own row); mobile nav FIXED (nav-mobile-toggle 36x36 visible at 390, opens nav-mobile-menu with all 5 chapter links + nav-mobile-link-free-ai-tools -> https://aiwebtools.app target=_blank, closes on link tap and scrolls to #chapter-01, scrollY 9573); price flicker FIXED (fresh random name qajccbonv showed 15 '· · ·' placeholders for the first ~7s, no stale $9.98, then real live prices $19.98/$9.99 streamed in progressively); hero video FIXED (single source /videos/hero-stock.mp4, currentSrc resolves to it, video.error=null); examples diversity FIXED (15/15 claim example cards with 8 examples each, no two identical; domain-card curated examples also all distinct). Regression at 1920: 'voting' resolved 15/15 in 1.2s (cached), all claim-card hrefs are clean https://freename.io/results?search=voting.<tld>&ref=olive-ears-obey with target=_blank (no %22/quotes), buy-button-transfermoney -> https://freename.io/discover/transfermoney?ref=olive-ears-obey target=_blank. One NEW real mobile defect: horizontal page overflow at 360px caused by the nav bar.

minor.issue: Every per-TLD keyword list still contains 'oil' and 'gold' (hard-coded in all 15 EXAMPLE_KEYWORDS entries), so those two names repeat on every card. Lists are otherwise distinct — cosmetic only.

ui_bugs.issue: Horizontal page overflow at 360x740: document.scrollWidth=369 vs viewport 360 (page scrolls 9px sideways). Nav inner row content measures 364px (logo block 182px + right group 158px [Browse hidden, FREENAME 110px + 36px hamburger] + px-6 = 48px padding) which exceeds 360px. Side effect: the 'AIWEBTOOLS.AI' logo text is visually clipped at the right edge. At 390px there is no overflow (scrollWidth 390).

Filter chips are only 24px tall at 390px (filter-chip-all ... filter-chip-worldtrader), well below the ~40px tap-target requirement; chain filters (filter-all/polygon/solana) are 35px and nav-logo 33px. Chips do wrap correctly with no overflow (container scrollWidth==clientWidth==342).

issues: Giant outlined 'AIWEBTOOLS' wordmark is clipped mid-word ('AIWEBTO') at the right edge — no document overflow, but reads as a rendering glitch on phones; consider scaling text-[Xvw] so the full word fits.
Logo lockup (AIWEBTOOLS.AI + 'PREMIUM WEB3 TLDS') plus FREENAME CTA plus hamburger is too wide for 360px; reduce logo font/tracking or hide the subtitle below 400px.

action_items: Fix 360px horizontal overflow: shrink nav logo (hide 'Premium Web3 TLDs' subtitle or reduce tracking) and/or reduce nav horizontal padding to px-4 below sm so the header row fits 360px.
Increase mobile tap-target height for [data-testid^="filter-chip-"] to >= 40px (add py-2.5 / min-h-[40px] on small screens).
Optional: scale the footer giant AIWEBTOOLS wordmark so it is not clipped mid-word on phones.
Optional: drop the repeated 'oil'/'gold' keywords from every EXAMPLE_KEYWORDS list in server.py for fully unique example sets.
critical_code_review_comments: ClaimYourName.jsx is still 291 lines mixing stream consumption, filters, examples grid and results grid — extract the NDJSON stream into a hook.
buyFor() in ClaimYourName.jsx still duplicates buyUrl() in data/domains.js and buy_url_for() in server.py — three copies of the referral URL format keeps the %22 regression risk alive.

DomainCard.jsx card-level onClick + nested anchors: the whole <article role="link"> triggers window.open while inner anchors stopPropagation — works, but a single anchor wrapper would be more accessible.

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (all 5 fixes verified + desktop regression pass; 1 new mobile overflow bug at 360px + small tap targets)

seed_data_creation: Backend suite inserts one TEST_ lead and one TEST_ status check via public API (no delete endpoint exists).
test_credentials: None needed; app has no auth and /app/memory/test_credentials.md is intentionally empty.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 iteration_1 fixes are verified fixed (buy-button overflow, mobile hamburger nav, price placeholder '· · ·' instead of stale seed price, single hero video source, per-TLD example diversity). Remaining known-unverifiable in headless Chromium: hero-stock.mp4 playback (H.264 cannot decode; currentSrc + no error verified). Fresh uncached name searches stream over ~20-30s; 'voting' is cached and resolves in ~1.2s. Only open frontend issue: 360px nav overflow (docScrollW 369 vs 360) and 24px-tall filter chips.
rca_of_the_issue: 360px overflow RCA: Nav inner container uses px-6 (48px total) and the logo block renders at its intrinsic 182px (font-mono2 text-sm tracking-[0.25em] 'AIWEBTOOLS.AI'); the right-hand group is 158px (FREENAME pill 110px + 36px hamburger + gap-3). 48+182+158 = 388px of content in a 360px viewport, so the flex row's scrollWidth becomes 364px and the document scrollWidth 369px, producing a 9px horizontal scroll and a clipped logo.
